transcript: We're gonna get a new Hudson Williams project in 2026. It was just announced that Hudson Williams is among the cast of the altruists, a new eight part limited series coming to Netflix that tells the true story of Sam Bainman, Fried and Caroline Elson. A modern day Gen Z. Bonnie and Clyde ultras was actually filmed in Vancouver last year and is expected to premiere on Netflix in the second half of 2026. All we know is that Hudson is a recurring member of the cast. He plays Duncan and he's a co founder of a cryptocurrency trading firm. Anyway, this sounds like a really fun project and it must be extremely exciting to them that they cast Hudson Williams before he blew up. I'm just excited we'll get some new Hudson Williams on our screens before 2027.
classificationReason: About a Netflix limited series casting announcement for 'The Altruists'; not related to any stage production.
